parameters.jsCode:
// Four customer emails. Each object in the array becomes one item in n8n.
return [
  { json: { id: "letter_1", text: `Hello,
I flew from Tel Aviv to Rome on 3 November with El Al, flight LY383. My suitcase did not arrive.
The airline confirmed in writing that it is lost (report ROM-LY-55821). Inside were clothes and a camera, total value about 6,500 ILS.
I have a travel policy with you, number TR-20931. What documents do I need to send to get compensation?
Thanks,
Sergei Katz` } },
  { json: { id: "letter_2", text: `Hi,
I'm planning a trip to Thailand in December. Does my travel policy cover scuba diving?
I don't remember my policy number.
Michal Ben-Ami` } },
  { json: { id: "letter_3", text: `Добрый день!
Две недели назад я отправил вам все документы по жалобе CL-5610 (ремонт машины после столкновения): счёт из гаража, фотографии и протокол.
С тех пор никто не ответил, а гараж требует оплату до конца месяца. Прошу сообщить, когда будет решение.
Даниэль Леви, полис 4471-22` } },
  { json: { id: "letter_4", text: `שלום,
אתמול בלילה פרצו לרכב שלי בחניה ליד הבית ברמת גן וגנבו את המחשב הנייד מהמושב האחורי. החלון האחורי נשבר.
הגשתי תלונה במשטרה. מספר הפוליסה שלי 4471-22. האם הביטוח מכסה גם את החלון וגם את המחשב?
דניאל לוי` } },
];

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number exactly as written. Not a claim number like CL-5610, not a flight or police report number. Empty if not written.

attributes.name: topic
attributes.description: One of: new_claim, claim_status, coverage_question, other. new_claim: reports a new event (accident, theft, loss) even if also asks about coverage; claim_status: asks about a claim already opened; coverage_question: asks what the policy covers, no new event

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: One of: English, Russian, Hebrew, Other
